detail.longDescription:
A friend contracted me to create an application for him. He's got a prototype version that he did through Claude. I wasn't trying to look at it or its internals because I want to think through the problem myself before consulting extant ideas that may color my thinking too much.

Anyhow, he sent over data that I needed and I'm writing an ETL first. Need to get this flat, unstructured data into something an application can use better.

I move the whole folder into my IDE for my own ergonomics and I hadn't gitignored it yet, so I get a pop up asking if I want to add the files to git and I notice a SHIT TON of Python.

I'm scrolling through these scripts one of them is `check-line54.py`

It's a python script that opens the application it extruded and loops over the lines and eventually prints out between lines 50 and 60.

I assume Claude was trying to debug something but now it's just haning out for all time.

#python #programming #ai
